creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The owner, 2026-11-02, from Foreman's phone app: "Maybe, from muster's perspective, maybe we want some sort of, uh, way to, um, allow the agents to recommend a specific option and express that through muster and inform and can render that."

Agents asking the owner a question say which answer they recommend in prose ("I recommend the first"). Wanted: `muster msg post --option ... ` can mark one option as the recommended one, the API carries it on the post (`NewPost` and the logged post), Muster's window shows it, and a client such as Foreman's phone app renders it. `muster docs msg` tells agents to use it when they have a recommendation. Foreman card: a_2sgOdZ0hm.
title: msg post: let a question mark one offered answer as recommended
